title_sq: Apartament 3+1+2+Verande per shitje ne zonen e 5-Majit
description_sq:
Super apartament 3+1+2 ne zonen e 5 Majit! Apartamenti ka nje siperfaqe prej 152 m2 neto + 60 metra Verande. Ndodhet ne katin e 8 dhe te fundit te nje pallati te ri, te ndertuar ne vitin 2021, dhe ka pamje te lire. Punimet jane teper cilesore, me investime qe perfshijne siistem qendror kondicionimi, termoizolim, panele diellore, Dritare dopioxham me izolim shume te mire akustik, etj, te cilat e bejne kete apartament nje hapesire teper komode dhe te rehatshme. Ka planimetri te rregullt dhe organizohet ne korridor hyres, sallon, kuzhine te vecuar, 3 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete, , garderobe, depo, dhe verande.
***Apartamenti ka si opsion dhe nje garazh te mbyllur me qepen me cmim 25'000 €, me cmim ekstra***
title_en: Apartment 3+1+2+Veranda for sale in the 5-May area
description_en: Super apartment 3+1+2 in the 5 May area! The apartment has a surface area of ​​152 m2 net + 60 meters Veranda. It is located on the 8th and last floor of a new building, built in 2021, and has a free view. The works are of high quality, with investments that include a central air conditioning system, thermal insulation, solar panels, double-glazed windows with very good acoustic insulation, etc., which make this apartment a very cozy and comfortable space. It has a regular floor plan and is organized into an entrance hall, living room, separate kitchen, 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, wardrobe, storage, and veranda. ***The apartment also has as an option a closed garage with a shutter at the price of €25,000, with an extra price***
